caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate andiron, typically used in a fireplace to support logs. The andiron is rendered in shades of gray and appears metallic, most likely iron. It consists of a vertical element topped with a spherical knob. Below the sphere, the vertical shaft has a decorative, undulating design with several bulbous and ridged protrusions. The base of the andiron is composed of three curved legs, each ending in a rounded foot, and the central section of the base features an embossed decorative motif. Extending horizontally from the vertical shaft is a straight bar, intended to support logs, which tapers toward the end. The background is plain and unadorned, with the object centered and occupying most of the frame. The image is monochromatic, executed in varying tones of charcoal or graphite on an off-white paper.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
